paper.title: Anthropic stock fell as low as $87.26 in the opening hours of its second day of trading, trimming gains from the $83 IPO price to as little as 5.1% (Bloomberg)
paper.abstract: Bloomberg : Anthropic stock fell as low as $87.26 in the opening hours of its second day of trading, trimming gains from the $83 IPO price to as little as 5.1% — Anthropic PBC shares erased much of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors' faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.
